issue.title: modify StackTraceFilter to not strip away "good" elements from the middle
issue.body:
according to javadoc of org.mockito.internal.exceptions.stacktrace.StackTraceFilter, filter works like this:
[a+, b+, c-, d+, e+, f-, g+] -> [a+, b+, g+]
it would be better to not strip away "good" d and e elements:
[a+, b+, c-, d+, e+, f-, g+] -> [a+, b+, d+, e+, g+]
What do you think about this? For me current behaviour is very inconvenient, I had to turn it off.

You're asking for the stack trace filter to keep the internal frames that sit between the non-Mockito frames (for example d and e in your a+, b+, c-, d+, e+, f-, g+ example), instead of dropping everything between the first and last good frame. That's a reasonable request, and it's logged for the backlog. Trimming too aggressively has come up before in issue 2238, so it's a known pain point."}
